text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- The National Assembly approved 1997 economic goals at its closing session on Tuesday including a growth rate of 10 percent, single digit inflation and an industrial production level of 14-14.5 percent.
-- Vietnam is planning to open up its rice export market next year by allowing both state and private enterprises to export the grain.
-- President Le Duc Anh has signed a decision bringing into effect cabinet changes approved by the National Assembly last week.
-- More than 4,530 people in Vietnam are known to be infected with the virus which causes AIDS with 563 suffering full-blown symptoms of the disease.
-- Vice Interior Minister Hoang Ngoc Nhat says inefficiencies in Vietnam's police and court systems are preventing criminals from being properly punished.
